clue.text: Match for Dickens?

definitions.meaning: an old name for a friction match, struck to light a fire
as in 'what the dickens', the dickens is the devil, and this is one of the devil's names

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are dictionary meanings of one word: an early wooden match, and a name for Satan, whom 'the dickens' also stands for.

clue.text: Shakespeare's king coherent, but losing head

indicators.note: losing its head means the word for coherent drops its first letter

parts.note: a coherent argument is a clear one

explanation.surface: A doddering stage monarch who still talks sense until he loses his mind.
explanation.definitionFit: The title role of King Lear, Shakespeare's tragedy about an ageing British monarch.

clue.text: Startlingly clear antithesis for dreamy schemes

indicators.note: startling things jolt and jumble, so the following letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is surprised to find a perfectly clear opposite for an idea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Startlingly' rearranges all fifteen letters of CLEAR ANTITHESIS.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for impractical daydreams: plans with no foundation, like buildings floating in the sky.

clue.text: Cooper's little effort family tree put first

indicators.note: tells us the tree comes before the family word, against the clue's order

parts.note: a fir is a conifer
kin means one's family or relatives

explanation.surface: A barrel-maker's modest piece of work, with genealogy thrown in.
explanation.walkthrough: A cooper makes barrels, so his 'little effort' is a small cask.
explanation.definitionFit: A small cask, a quarter of a barrel, is just the kind of thing a cooper, or barrel-maker, would make.

clue.text: Command to include singular advice for the incompetent?

indicators.note: the word for command takes the singular letter inside it

parts.note: to reign is to hold command or rule
S is the grammar abbreviation for singular

explanation.surface: An order that slips in a word of advice for those not up to their jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: Telling a hopeless office-holder to quit their post is the one piece of advice that fits them; the question mark flags the joke.

clue.text: Change light's direction on river in particular

parts.note: RE means on or concerning, as in a letter heading

indicators.note: the river letter goes inside the word for particular

parts.note: a particular is a detail or fact
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Light bends as it crosses a particular river.
explanation.definitionFit: Physics term: a lens or water surface bends a ray as it passes from one medium into another.

clue.text: Put in new place on exercise aboard carrier

parts.note: RE means on or concerning

indicators.note: the exercise word is carried inside the carrier word

parts.note: a hod is a builder's trough for carrying bricks
to use a right is to exercise it

explanation.surface: Someone is moved to a new posting while on a training exercise on board an aircraft carrier.
explanation.definitionFit: To give people a new home is to settle them somewhere fresh.

clue.text: Total jerk makes delivery

parts.note: full means total or complete
to toss is to jerk or throw

explanation.surface: An utter idiot performs a delivery.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a full toss is a ball that reaches the batsman without bouncing.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket term for a kind of bowled ball, one that fails to bounce before reaching the batter.

clue.text: In which one imperilled mortal flees war?

definitions.text: In which one imperilled mortal flees war?

parts.note: A means one, as in a single thing

indicators.note: putting something in danger shakes it up, so the following letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A description of a story where a man in danger deserts the fighting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Imperilled' rearranges MORTAL FLEES WAR; A for 'one' starts the title. The whole clue also describes the book.
explanation.definitionFit: Hemingway's novel, whose hero Frederic Henry is wounded and then deserts the Italian army in the First World War.

clue.text: Book time in LA clubs, perhaps going up together

indicators.note: the time letter is set inside the reversed letters
in a down entry, going up means the letters read bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: clubs is one example of a suit in cards
people who are at one, or one, are united, together

explanation.surface: Someone books time in Los Angeles nightclubs, perhaps as a couple heading upmarket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going up' turns both LA and the suit backwards, and 'in' places the time letter inside. Clubs is one card suit, hence 'perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: The third Gormenghast novel by Mervyn Peake, so a book by title.

clue.text: Ocean flows west to Irish gods

indicators.note: in an across entry, flowing west means reading right to left, backwards

parts.note: an ocean is a sea

explanation.surface: The sea carries something westward towards the gods of Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: The principal Norse pantheon, which includes Odin and Thor.

clue.text: Rowdy Scots hail old commentator

indicators.note: a rowdy crowd is disorderly, so the following letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Boisterous Scotsmen greet an elderly pundit.
explanation.definitionFit: A scholar of antiquity who wrote notes in the margins of classical texts, an ancient annotator.

clue.text: Big prop on wing though accompanied by lock

indicators.note: says the lock word comes along after the first pieces

parts.note: a bird on the wing is flying
but means though, as a conjunction
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: A large support on an aircraft wing, though it comes with a lock.
explanation.definitionFit: An arched external support propping up the wall of a large building, typical of Gothic cathedrals.

clue.text: What's to dissolve gradually? See Euclid, flustered, taking question!

indicators.note: the jumbled letters take the question letter in among them
a flustered person is in a muddle, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: An exclamation urging someone to look at the mathematician, rattled by a question.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flustered' rearranges SEE EUCLID into DELIUESCE, and 'taking' places Q inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To melt away slowly, especially as a salt does when it absorbs moisture from the air and becomes liquid.

clue.text: Rest in peace as everlasting

indicators.note: the answer is held inside the run of letters of the following words

explanation.surface: An epitaph: may the dead rest in eternal peace.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym for relaxation or repose: to be at rest is to be at leisure.

clue.text: Marine mammal, without female, left home for snail

indicators.note: in the old sense of outside: the mammal's letters go around the others

parts.note: a seal is a sea-dwelling mammal
she is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: A seal, separated from its mate, has abandoned the place a snail calls home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' here is the old word for outside, not lacking: the mammal wraps around the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A loosely apt description: a mollusc's shell is its home, and shells on the shore once housed sea snails.

clue.text: Stiffened sailor about to enter hut

indicators.note: the sailor and about letters go into the hut word

parts.note: a shed is a hut
a tar is a sailor
C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A sailor goes stiff before stepping into a hut.
explanation.definitionFit: Collars and shirts treated with starch are stiffened, so the past participle fits.

clue.text: Corbynites, silent about disastrous sign, close to revolt

indicators.note: the silent word wraps around the other letters

parts.note: keeping mum means staying silent
an omen is a sign, often of disaster

indicators.note: the close of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Supporters of a Labour leader keep quiet about a bad sign, close to rebellion.
explanation.walkthrough: Momentum was the grassroots movement backing Jeremy Corbyn as leader of Britain's Labour Party.
explanation.definitionFit: The campaigning group formed to support Jeremy Corbyn's Labour leadership; its members are Corbynites.

clue.text: One into gin drunkenly finds point of combustion

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: a drunk staggers about, so the following letters are reeled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who has had too much gin bursts into flames.
explanation.definitionFit: The moment when fuel catches fire in an engine, the start of combustion.

clue.text: Northern mountain viewed from East in drawing

indicators.note: in an across entry, seen from the east means read right to left

parts.note: an alp is a mountain

explanation.surface: A landscape sketch of a northern peak seen from the east.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan is a technical drawing, such as an architect's layout of a building.

clue.text: Person abusing horse for example

parts.note: horse is slang for heroin, so someone who abuses it is a drug user

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests cruelty to an animal, but horse is slang for heroin.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone dependent on a drug such as heroin, which users call horse.

clue.text: Prayer from crew on capsized craft

parts.note: to man a vessel is to crew it

indicators.note: in a down entry, an overturned word is read from the bottom up

parts.note: art means craft or skill

explanation.surface: Sailors pray aboard a boat that has turned over.
explanation.definitionFit: A chant or sacred phrase repeated in prayer and meditation, as in Hindu and Buddhist practice.

clue.text: King in uniform there with knight and lizard seizing power

parts.note: U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: the group of pieces grabs the power letter and holds it inside

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for power
N is the chess notation for knight
the Komodo dragon is a lizard

explanation.surface: A monarch in uniform stands there with a knight and a lizard that grabs power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seizing' puts the power letter inside the run formed by the three pieces after the uniform letter. N for knight is chess notation, since K is the king.
explanation.definitionFit: In Arthurian legend, the king of Britain who fathered King Arthur.

clue.text: Suffering sons put to bed?

indicators.note: the sons letter is put into the bed word

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
S is the abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: Sad children are sent to bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Cost can mean loss or suffering, as in learning something to one's cost.

clue.text: Pasta shortly to be cooked with eight for some food

indicators.note: cooked ingredients are changed, so these letters are rearranged
cut short, the word drops its last letter

explanation.surface: Pasta, soon to be cooked with eight other things to make a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shortly' cuts PASTA to PAST, and 'to be cooked' rearranges that with EIGHT. 'Pasta' looks like the definition but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Long thin strands of pasta are a well-known kind of food, so 'some food' is a broad description.

clue.text: Body part temperature given approximately

parts.note: 'or so' means approximately, as in ten or so

explanation.surface: Someone's body temperature is a rough estimate.
explanation.definitionFit: The human trunk, the part of the body without head or limbs.

clue.text: Mark, joining Liberal Party after consideration, gets title

indicators.note: says the following pieces come after the consideration word
says the mark letter joins on to the others

parts.note: to give someone a fair ear is to give them consideration
a do is a party
M is the abbreviation for mark, the old German currency

explanation.surface: Someone called Mark joins the Liberal Party after thinking it over and is given a peerage.
explanation.definitionFit: The rank or domain of an earl, a British noble title.

clue.text: Bird swallowing managed seconds for journey

indicators.note: the bird word takes the others inside it

parts.note: a tit is a small bird
ran means managed, as a business

explanation.surface: A bird gulps down food in seconds before setting off.
explanation.definitionFit: Transit means passage from one place to another, a trip or journey.
